{"user":"I need an email to send to our vendor asking for an updated quote and delivery timeline. Can you draft it in a professional tone and include a couple of specifics I provide? The specifics: we need 500 units, requested ship date is end of May, and we’d like pricing broken out by unit cost and any bulk discounts.","plus_response":"Subject: Request for Updated Quote and Delivery Timeline (500 units)

Hi [Vendor Name],

Could you please provide an updated quote and delivery timeline for the following?

- Quantity: 500 units
- Requested ship date: end of May
- Pricing format: please break out unit cost and any applicable bulk discounts

If you have options that differ by configuration or lead time, feel free to include those as well, along with the earliest confirmed ship date.

Once available, please also share the quote validity period and any assumptions tied to manufacturing or components.

Thanks in advance,
[Your Name]
[Title]
[Company]

—
If you want, I can also rewrite this as a shorter version for a ticket submission portal, and I can draft a one-paragraph follow-up email to send if we don’t hear back within 3 business days.","minus_response":"Subject: Request for Updated Quote & Delivery Timeline (500 units)

Hi [Vendor Name],

Please send an updated quote and delivery timeline for 500 units. We’re targeting an end-of-May ship date, and we need pricing broken out by unit cost and any bulk discounts.

I should leave some of the work to you—if there’s any quote validity period or lead-time assumptions you want included, you can specify what you prefer in the reply or tell me and I’ll incorporate it.

Thanks,
[Your Name]"}
